verdict.rationale: Zero's founder says the client drafts replies, and the MCP docs list composing emails with AI assistance and creating drafts that can be sent later. That supports AI-drafted replies ready for review. Nothing in the evidence shows the drafts learn or match the user's own voice and tone, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: documented voice/tone personalization (learning from sent mail or style settings), evidence that drafts are non-generic, first-party feature docs beyond the MCP list, and independent hands-on corroboration of draft quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: Zero founder describes it as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox
